games.cause: Killed by a gnome lord in The Gnomish Mines (Dlvl 3) at XP level 1, 9/16 HP: flanked by a gnome lord + hobbit, chose to fight instead of ascending the escape-hatch upstairs, took a 9-dmg hit and died.
lessons: Flanked at low HP by a 'lord' monster -> ascend the up-stairs you arrived on; do NOT trade blows in the open. The escape hatch was set up but not used.
Reached Dlvl 3 / the Mines at XP level 1 (under-leveled). The Dlvl 2-4 down-branch can be the lethal Gnomish Mines; grind XP before going deeper.
Carried an UNREAD blessed scroll of identify + an uncursed ring of sustain ability at death — reading identify (safe) would have IDed the ring. Don't hoard usable ID/escape items.
Wasted ~60 turns on a pet-held ring chase and forcing an EMPTY locked box, gaining 0 XP -> stayed level 1. Prioritise XP/progress over marginal loot.
Identified at death: ring of sustain ability, scroll of identify (tiger-eye-ring / KERNOD-WEL appearances this game).

games.cause: Killed by a gnome mummy in the Gnomish Mines (Dlvl 5) at XP level 6. A rolling-boulder trap cut HP from 31 to 14; resting in an exposed cavern allowed enemies to close, and the mummy dealt the final blow at 1 HP.
lessons: Never rest while a hostile is visible or in an open Mines cavern after taking trap damage. Break line of sight and create several tiles of separation first; wait:N can let a full-speed enemy close and attack.

After a major trap hit leaves HP below 25%, stop exploring unknown tiles and prioritize the known upstairs or a defensible retreat. The second rolling-boulder trigger happened while moving onto the same trapped square at 3 HP.
Read safe unidentified scrolls before a crisis when identification can reveal healing or escape resources. An uncursed scroll of identify was still unread at death.
An unidentified consumable is not a reliable one-turn escape at 1 HP with an adjacent pursuer; using it spends the turn and still permits the monster's attack.
